# AI OS Installer

> Conversational AI-guided Linux installer — describe what you want, the AI handles the rest.

## What it does

Replaces the traditional Linux installation wizard with a conversation. Instead of navigating
menus or reading documentation, you describe your use case in plain language and the AI
configures and installs Ubuntu 24.04 LTS for you.

## Who it is for

- Developers setting up a new Linux workstation
- DevOps engineers automating VM provisioning
- Linux beginners intimidated by traditional installers

## How to use it

```bash
docker run -it --privileged \
  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<your-key> \
  ghcr.io/gauthierbraillon/ai-os-installer:latest
```

```
AI: Hi! What will you mainly use this Linux system for?
You: Web development and some gaming
AI: I'll set up Node, Docker, VS Code, Steam, and configure GPU drivers.
    Simple setup or detailed customization?
You: Simple
AI: Installing now...
```

## Technology

- Language: Go 1.22
- AI: Claude API (Anthropic)
- Target OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
- VM backend: QEMU
- Distribution: Docker container

## Key capabilities

- Natural language requirement gathering
- Automatic package selection based on use case
- Generates Ubuntu preseed / cloud-init config from conversation
- Runs unattended installation inside a QEMU VM

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/gauthierbraillon/ai-os-installer
